description: Header file defining functions and constants for device download/upload operations in a DM (Device Management) context, including function prototypes for download, upload, getting queued transfers, and initialization.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_DoDownload
methods.description: Initiates a device download operation with specified parameters.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_DoUpload
methods.description: Initiates a device upload operation with specified parameters.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_GetQueuedTransfers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of queued transfer operations.
